The '''Galactic Alliance Security Detention Center 81''' was a [[Galactic Alliance Security]] [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse|blockhouse]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Valin Horn|Valin]] and [[Jysella Horn]] fell prey to a [[Force psychosis]], they were captured by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encased]] in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], and placed in the Detention Center. Soon afterward, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] acquired a document allowing them visitation rights, and brought the press in tow. They showed that the Horns were being kept as prizes by Security [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Wruq Retk]], turning public sympathy in favor of the [[New Jedi Order]]'s plight.

Later, in [[44 ABY]], the Order plotted a [[Raid on Detention Center 81|raid]] to free the Horns from the Detention Center.
